facts.fact: 她是对的：自从她拿斧头劈了她，她就变成了她一直想成为的那种人
facts.anchor: She was right. Ever since I’d hit her with the axe, she’d become everything I’d ever wanted to be.

facts.fact: 仿佛两人对调了，只是她仍然是原来的自己——这就是她失败的原因
facts.anchor: It was as if we’d switched somehow. Only I was still just me. That’s why I’d failed.

facts.fact: "你得记住，你要去的地方，只是空无。"
facts.anchor: “You have to remember, the place where you’re going, it’s just emptiness.”

facts.fact: "你要是干脆……不存在，不是更好吗？"
facts.anchor: “Wouldn’t it be better if you just, y’know”—she leaned closer to me—“didn’t exist?”

facts.fact: "那里没有任何你原本不知道的东西。"
facts.anchor: “There’s nothing there that you didn’t already know in the first place.”

facts.fact: "把戏服拉链拉开，淡出去吧。不用再假装，不用再挣扎。"
facts.anchor: “Just unzip the costume and fade away,” she continued. “No more pretending. No more struggling.

facts.fact: 空无爬到了她脚的边缘
facts.anchor: The void found the edges of my feet.

facts.fact: "这会是一种解脱，对吧？对所有人。包括你。"
facts.anchor: “It would be a relief, right?” Her eyes were wide, wide as her hungry mouth. “A relief for everyone. Even you.”

facts.fact: 她闭眼深吸一口气："是的，这就是地狱。"
facts.anchor: I closed my eyes and took a deep breath. “Yes,” I said. “This is hell.”

facts.fact: "我们在地狱里。"她的笑在嘴角化掉了一点："闭上你的臭嘴。"
facts.anchor: “We’re in hell,” I said. And her grin melted at the corners a little. “Shut your whore mouth.”

facts.fact: 如果她自己的影子就是她，那么这片黑暗都属于她，连同随之而来的真相
facts.anchor: If I was my own shadow, then all this darkness belonged to me. As did the truth that came with it.

facts.fact: "你说得对。我恨这一切。我每天都在努力成为另一个人。"
facts.anchor: “You’re right,” I said. “I hate this. I spend every day trying to be someone else.

facts.fact: 她像抱孩子一样把她抱进怀里；她抓挠挣扎，她抱紧不放——就像那些故事，就像《Tam Lin》
facts.anchor: I gathered her into my arms like a child. She scrabbled and fought, but I held on. Just like the stories. Just like in Tam Lin.

facts.fact: 她不在乎她变成什么：蛇、蜘蛛还是火
facts.anchor: And I didn’t care what she turned herself into whether it was snakes or spiders or fire.

facts.fact: "你长出谁都刺不穿的硬鳞，"她说，"也没人能看透你。"
facts.anchor: “You grew tough scaly skin that no one could pierce,” I said, “or see you through.”

facts.fact: "你乱挥爪，这样没人能靠近到伤害你——也没人能靠近到治愈你。"
facts.anchor: “You lashed out so no one could come close enough to hurt you,” I said, “or heal you.”

facts.fact: "因为你太渴望被爱。因为你从不相信有人会自愿留下。"
facts.anchor: “Because you were so hungry for love. Because you never trusted anyone to stay out of choice.”

facts.fact: "我们做过可怕的事，"她说，"但我不认为我们就是那样的人。"
facts.anchor: “We’ve done monstrous things,” I said. “But I don’t think that’s who we are.

facts.fact: "那我们究竟是谁？"她亲了亲她的头顶："回家吧，我的小影子，我们一起弄清楚。"
facts.anchor: “But then,” she said quietly, “who are we really?” I kissed the top of her head. “Come home, my little shadow, and let’s find out.”

facts.fact: 然后两栋房子之间的门被吹开，她被一团褐色尘土吞没
facts.anchor: Then the door between the two houses blew open and I was engulfed in a cloud of brown dust.
